riders: The Hearth sheds Bright Light 15 feet and Dim Light another 15 feet. Resolve ordinary fuel ignition and weather discomfort outside combat.
description: Create one destructible cultivated flame in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. Choose which allies receive its benefits. For 8 hours, chosen allies within 15 feet have Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened, environmental cold, and Exhaustion caused by exposure. Creating another Hearth replaces it.

riders: After a short rest in the Hearth aura, choose one benefit: regain Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus; gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus; end one level of Exhaustion caused by travel, hunger, thirst, exposure, ordinary smoke, or environmental hardship; gain Advantage on your next save against being Frightened before the end of the next scene; or end one ordinary environmental penalty caused by cold, rain, smoke, altitude, poor shelter, or damp conditions. A creature may receive this benefit once per long rest.
description: Shield the Flame: when an ally in your Hearth aura takes damage, spend your Reaction and 1 Qi to reduce it by 1d8 + your key ability modifier (2d8 at CL14; 3d8 at CL18), once per round. The reduction applies after Resistance and before Temporary Hit Points or Hit Points are lost.

riders: Carry the Hearth can also center on your Domain Armament. Hearthward Pavilion’s supernatural benefits move with it, though civic shelter does not.
description: Your active Hearth follows you or a willing ally carrying the real flame for 1 minute. Its aura expands to 20 feet. Allies gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns; enemies entering or starting in the aura make a Dexterity save against 2d8 Fire or Radiant damage, taking half damage on a success. Shield the Flame reduces damage by 2d8 + your key ability modifier while you carry the Hearth.

riders: Folded Arsenal does not require separate activation or Qi. All four Folded Arsenal Modes function simultaneously.
Paper assets inside the field lose Vulnerability to Fire. Paper Dragon costs 2 Qi instead of 5 and does not require Concentration while entirely inside the field. Paper Clone costs 2 Qi instead of 5.

Folded Aid: Once during each of your turns, choose one ally inside the field and grant one effect: Half Cover until the start of your next turn; Move it up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; Grant Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus; Grant Advantage on its next Dexterity saving throw; Create a paper bridge, stair, or platform up to 20 feet long; Move your Domain Armament up to 20 feet. A creature can receive one Folded Aid per turn.

Thousand-Fold Exchange: Paper Exchange costs 0 Qi once per round during Paper Heaven. After Paper Exchange destroys a Clone: Create a replacement Clone in your former space at the end of the current turn; This replacement has the normal 1 Hit Point; You can create one replacement per round.
Dragon of the Written Sky: Once during the activation, create a Paper Dragon without using an Action or paying Qi. It disappears when Paper Heaven ends.
description: Create a 60-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Paper Heaven for 1 minute with Concentration. Hostiles treat it as difficult terrain. A hostile entering for the first time during a turn or starting inside makes a Dexterity save: 5d8 Slashing or Force damage and Blinded until its next turn starts on failure, half damage on success.
